question: By what agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to Māyā?
premises: The extent reaches up to Māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
